_comment: Pins RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.6 item 9 outside Decision Mode: SessionCancel, SessionSuspend and SessionResume submitted via Send are rejected FORBIDDEN by a mode-independent check, leave the session OPEN, and do not disturb the accepted ApprovalRequest. core_runtime_annotation_reject_paths.json pins the same rule in Decision Mode.
description: Core lifecycle in Quorum Mode: runtime-emitted annotations submitted via Send are rejected FORBIDDEN.

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.6 item 9: SessionCancel is runtime-emitted and MUST be rejected with FORBIDDEN when submitted through Send, in every Mode. The sender is a declared voter, so it passes Quorum's own sender authorization; a runtime that let the envelope reach Mode dispatch would report INVALID_ENVELOPE instead.

RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.6 item 9: SessionSuspend is runtime-emitted and MUST be rejected with FORBIDDEN when submitted through Send, in every Mode. The sender is a declared voter, so it passes Quorum's own sender authorization; a runtime that let the envelope reach Mode dispatch would report INVALID_ENVELOPE instead.

RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.6 item 9: SessionResume is runtime-emitted and MUST be rejected with FORBIDDEN when submitted through Send, in every Mode. The sender is a declared voter, so it passes Quorum's own sender authorization; a runtime that let the envelope reach Mode dispatch would report INVALID_ENVELOPE instead.
The rejected annotations changed nothing: the session is still OPEN and accepts a ballot.
